title: LinkedIn Job Change Tracker and Alerts
description: LinkedIn job change tracker. Watch a list of profile URLs on a schedule and get a row when the employer or headline changes. The first run saves a baseline. Later runs alert only on a change, including a webhook. Starting from $0.30 per 1,000 checks.

urlsCsv.title: Or paste CSV
urlsCsv.description: Header: url. Current Company Checker also accepts previousCompany.

fileUrl.title: Or upload a CSV file
fileUrl.description: CSV with a url or linkedinUrl column.

maxUrls.title: Maximum URLs
maxUrls.description: Cost-control cap. Maximum 100,000. A run that stops continues on the next schedule.

concurrency.title: Concurrent requests
concurrency.description: How many watched profile URLs to check at the same time.

watchId.title: Watch list ID
watchId.description: Stable ID for this list. Reuse it on every scheduled run.

stateStoreName.title: State store name
stateStoreName.description: Named persistent key-value store holding the previous snapshot.

webhookUrl.title: Change webhook URL (optional)
webhookUrl.description: HTTPS endpoint receiving changed rows only. The baseline run sends no webhook.
